remix.rule: The shipped film states no figures, because these are demonstrations rather than results. Substitute real numbers only if you can stand behind them — a personalised demo carries more weight, which is exactly why an invented number in one does more damage.

approval.note: A storyboard is a script, not footage. Every claim is qualitative rather than invented — a demo that fabricates a metric teaches the viewer something false, so this script says an agent accelerates a task and never says by how much. A human approves the script before anything is rendered.

scenes.narration: But what if the manager wants to go a step further? The agent handles the analysis and offers a set of targeted recommendations right in their workflow. Work like this used to require cross-referencing different systems by hand. Now, with unified data context across The ERP and Line telemetry, the agent can rapidly generate a phased plan with quick wins. For risk mitigation, the agent helps as well, outlining a strategy that keeps the work on track. When the detail is needed, they simply ask, and the agent quickly compiles a clear summary. It can go further in the same conversation, without anyone switching tools. Finally, the agent creates a monitoring plan, so teams keep the effort aligned to the metrics they are measured on. With Maintenance Scheduling Agent, manufacturers get guided assistance embedded directly into their workflows.
